hypothesis: The likely remaining lever is not a new model family but a less biased checkpoint-selection rule: train the incumbent FM+BPR+recency+hour_plus_dow configuration once, capture per-epoch validation predictions, and choose between single-best-epoch and top-5-epoch averaging using held-out user splits from validation rather than the same users used for the final score. This directly tests whether the current same-validation checkpoint rule is overfitting; if so, cross-fitted selection could recover a small real gain (~0.0003-0.0008 primary), and if not it will provide a cleaner confirmation that checkpoint combining is already saturated. After this run, a paired multi-seed CONFIRM is due before acting on any tiny gain.
